implementation_status.note: Machine-readable mirror of the README 'Implemented vs. promised' table. 'state' is one of: implemented, partial, not_implemented. An entry whose state is not 'implemented' must not be presented as a working feature.

entries.promise: Six-axis registry, version stamping, submission contract, append-only datasets
Deterministic generator, rule audit, coverage report

entries.caveat: The text gate is an uncalibrated heuristic; no human-labelled calibration set exists.
Rule-based guard with no embedding model; uncalibrated.

entries.promise: Four background ablations with an isolated three-arm intervention (six conditions)
entries.caveat: Never executed against a real model. The intervention arms run only under the distilled background, which is the one that excludes the target constraint; the full 4x3 factorial was removed because the target's own text sits in the full_context and raw_turns histories.
E excludes provider failures from the curve instead of scoring them as violations; F's token counter is a chars/4 heuristic.

entries.promise: Judge protocol (three heterogeneous judges, two-class calibration)
entries.caveat: Scorer side only (judge_calibration); no judge is wired to a provider yet.

entries.promise: Eleven-step generation pipeline, BM25+MPNet semantic-disconnect filter
entries.caveat: The shipped filter is a character-bigram approximation and says so in the generator config.

entries.promise: Human annotation, kappa, adjudication, gold freeze
entries.caveat: The machinery is implemented and the chain is exercised end to end, but no human has filled a sheet yet: no kappa has been measured and no gold has been frozen.

entries.promise: Annotation chain: answer-free sheets, boundary tags, kappa-only gate, adjudication, provenance-checked gold freeze
entries.caveat: The chain is exercised end to end by tests/test_annotation_pipeline.py. The freeze refuses generator or AI provenance, requires two distinct annotation sets and annotators, recomputes and cross-checks the agreement report, compares label content (not just markers) with every shipped generator truth file before and after adjudication, and refuses a reviewer who is one of the annotators. Parsed sheets declare provenance unknown unless a source is stated. Distractors are optional and, when attached, are disclosed as dataset truth rather than human annotation.

entries.promise: P1 orthogonality matrix, prompt-sensitivity study, contamination probe
Scorer thresholds fitted on a human-labelled calibration set
entries.caveat: configs/calibration.json is still 'uncalibrated' and the two gates in scoring.py are hand-picked. scripts/fit_thresholds.py fits them out-of-fold once human gold exists and refuses to write a calibrated config without a third-party adjudicator.

entries.promise: Capability profile: retention, pruning, trap marking
entries.caveat: The three scorers exist and are tested, but no dialogue carries trap gold yet, so the trap axis reports 'not evaluated' rather than a zero. No model has been scored with them.

dataset_policy.note: Never edit data/pilot_v0 in place. A new sample set goes to data/contrib/<dataset_id>/ with its own dataset.json.
